subject: TOURN: System II placement (1st/2nd/3rd) + participation badge, server-awarded from the frozen result
description:
The October deliverable the 4-way vote (2026-09-07) left standing. IN-PLATFORM ONLY -- explicitly NOT the external LinkedIn credential, which is descoped to the HCA (task 363). Constitutional principle 2 (HCA doc line 56): competition never automatically grants a credential, so these are separate systems and must be labelled as such to students. Award pattern already proven in-tree: users/{uid}/server_awards/{badgeId} plus achievements: FieldValue.arrayUnion(badgeId), same shape as awardMissionBadge/awardCourseBadge. Badge ids must NOT collide with the gate_N / dark_arts_gateN namespace -- deriveXP pays 500 XP per gate string and recordProgress/syncProgress reject that shape (GUARD-05). Placement fans out from the team members[] uid array to each member. HARD DEPENDENCY on task 362: the award must read a results-of-record snapshot, not a live re-sort, or the badge inherits the same forgeable-placement defect. Tie-break itself is live and correct (BUG-022). Open design question carried over from HCA doc line 171: do all team members receive the same placement badge (CTF standard), and are individual specialty awards separate?
[2026-09-07 23:08] UNBLOCKED by 362 (committed 5ce97a33a). The badge must read tournaments/{id}/results/final, never the live teams collection - that is the whole point of 362. Placement fans out from the record's frozen members[] array, which is the attribution bridge captured AT finalization. NOTE the inherited limit: BUG-254 means a placement is tamper-evident after certification and unprotected before it, so the badge must not be described as proof of anything stronger.
[2026-09-08 02:34] PARTICIPATION SHIPPED efa36161a. Functions ctfJoinTeam + ctfAwardTournamentBadges DEPLOYED and verified via functions:list; hosting deploying. Chris PASS after re-running badges 21/21, join integration 15/15, trophy render checkpoint. DESIGN: split by revocability - participation is never revoked so it lives in achievements (union-merged) where the trophy cabinet sees it; placements are revocable so they live in server_awards ONLY, because a revoked id in achievements is resurrected by any stale device's next sync (GUARD-04/BUG-266). Nancy BLOCKED the first design over exactly that. DEFECT FOUND BY THE INTEGRATION TEST: an admin-placed roster member could never earn the badge - 'existing' is computed from the teams' members arrays so they hit the function-level early return before the award. Fixed. NOT DONE: placement badges have NO display surface (TrophyCabinet reads localStorage; placements deliberately are not there). A champion cannot see their trophy. That is the follow-on.
[2026-09-08 03:46] PROVEN IN PRODUCTION 2026-09-08. ctfBackfillParticipation deployed (b4508486e) and RUN against Special Event: awarded 1/1, badge doc created, entry present, verifiedJoin=false + backfilled=true (honest - we cannot know if they typed a code), and the id reached users/{uid}.achievements so the trophy cabinet sees it. Re-run returned awarded:0 skipped:1, proving idempotency and the transaction guard against PRODUCTION Firestore, not just the emulator. Combined with the deployed artifact being byte-identical by sha256 to the source that passed join integration 15/15, the production award path is demonstrated end to end. Earlier gap now closed: students already on a roster (joined before the feature, or admin-placed) previously could never receive the badge.
